case.title: Edit Work Order saves a new lead and a new mileage together
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • 2 technicians eligible at this location: active, Role Technician, at least one Department, Location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, Time Clock on. Names are examples ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" (used by this case only) with one contact and one asset.
  • One Approved work order [WO-1] with one approved line, Lead Technician = [Tech-A] and Mileage 120,000.
  • Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard").
  2. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-B] (the expected results call this technician "Ralph Edwards"). Use a second, different technician.
  3. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > Asset = its asset > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-712").
  5. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  6. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-A]. (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  7. On the status card click Mileage, type 120000 and click outside the field (it saves when you leave it).
  8. Check the setup worked: reload [WO-1]. Lead Technician reads [Tech-A] and Mileage reads 120,000.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] (Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > click the work order).
  2. There is no separate Edit Work Order window; the edits are made on the status card (the card at the left of the work order page that shows the status, Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours).
  3. On the status card click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-B]. It saves at once.
  4. On the status card click Mileage, change it to 120500 and click outside the field (it saves when you leave it).
  5. Watch for any error message.
  6. Reload the page and read Lead Technician and Mileage on the status card.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 to 5: both changes save with no error message.
  • Step 6: Lead Technician reads "Ralph Edwards" and Mileage reads 120,500. Both changes were saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, given with screenshots after we reported that no Edit Work Order window opens for an existing work order. Part A, word for word: “For Lead technician. There are two places as appearing in the screenshots. The work order can not be edited directly, you edit their lines by navigating to the work order first and then by clicking each line on the work order. Yes the rest can be done from the cards appearing at the left on each work order. And Yes, ideally those checks use that card instead.” The steps were moved to the status card on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 1: “Edit Work Order: the lead now goes through the new shared path.”
  • QA handoff §7: “A successful change shows the new lead.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/9/2026.

changes.label: Preconditions
changes.old_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Regression Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. To create a work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the case customer and its asset > create it, and write down the number the build gives it (the numbers in this case are examples, e.g. "S1-702").
  7. Create one work order for the case customer (e.g. "S1-712"), set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard", enter a mileage (e.g. 120,000), add one line and approve it so the status reads Approved.
